welcome-sub: Gedhi reKusimbaradza Africa kuburikidza nePi Ecosystem
africa-day: (Mukupemberera Zuva reAfrica re25, chirongwa ichi chekudzidzisa Pi Pioneers chatangwa)
intro-p1: Pi Network imari yedhijitari uye chirongwa chepasi rose chakagadzirirwa kuita kuti cryptocurrency iwanikwe uye ibatsire munhu wese.
intro-p2: Kusiyana nemamwe macryptocurrency anoda michina inodhura yemigodhi, Pi Network inobvumira vanhuwo zvavo kutora chikamu zvakananga kubva kumafoni avo.
ch1-p1: Nhanho 1: Dhawunirodha Pi Network - Shandisa chinongedzo: minepi.com/chigalex1
ch1-p2: Nhanho 2: Nyoresa neFacebook kana Foni → Isa kodhi: CHIGALEX1 → Tora mubairo we1 Pi
ch1-p3: Kuchera Kwemazuva Ese: Dzoka maawa makumi maviri nemana oga oga wodzvanya bhatani remheni kuti uenderere mberi nekuchera.
security-msg: ⚠️ Chengetedzo yeWallet: Usambofa wakagovana mazwi ako makumi maviri nemana epassphrase! Chikwata chePi Core hachife chakakukumbira!
ch2-p1: Pi Wallet yako ibhangi rako muPi Ecosystem. Inochengeta mari yako yePi zvakachengeteka pa blockchain.
ch5-p1: Global Consensus Value (GCV) inokurudzira kushandiswa chaiko. 1 Pi = $314,159 GCV. Kukosha uku kunovakwa nemapiyona vachishandisa Pi mukutengeserana chaiko.
final-msg: Africa ine mukana wekuve imwe yenzvimbo dzakasimba mukushandiswa kunoshanda mukati mePi Ecosystem. Pamwe Chete Tinovaka. Pamwe Chete Tinodzidzisa.
